paite: Huchi in Zeruiah tapa Joab in kumpipa lungsim Absalom tung ah a-om chih ana thei hi.
heading: Joab In Absalom Hong Kikdan Ding Agel
english: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king’s heart was toward Absalom.

paite: Huchi in Joab in Tekoa ah mi asawl a, huai a numei pil khat ava pisak hi. Akiang ah, "Lusuun bang in kibawl inla, lusuun puan silh inla, sathau leng kinilh lou in numei sawtpi misi suun bang in om in.
english: Joab sent to Tekoa and brought a wise woman from there, and said to her, “Please act like a mourner, and put on mourning clothing, please, and don’t anoint yourself with oil; but be as a woman who has mourned a long time for the dead.

paite: Kumpipa kiang ah hoh inla, akiang ah hichibang in thu va gen in aw,"” achi hi. Huchi in Joab in akam ah thute amuam hi.
english: Go in to the king and speak like this to him.” So Joab put the words in her mouth.

paite: Tekoa a numei in kumpipa kiang a thu gen ding in amai a lei si in abokkhup a, zahtakna pia in, "Kumpipa aw, hon huh in," achi hi.
english: When the woman of Tekoa spoke to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, showed respect, and said, “Help, O king!”

paite: Kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Bangchidan ahia?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Meithai petmah ka hi a, ka pasal asita hi.
english: The king said to her, “What ails you?” She answered, “Truly I am a widow, and my husband is dead.

paite: Na sikhanu'n tapa nih anei a, anih un lou ah akisual ua, kuamah phelh ding lah a-om kei a, akhat pen in adang asat a, athatta hi.
english: Your servant had two sons; and they both fought together in the field, and there was no one to part them, but the one struck the other and killed him.

paite: Ngai in, a-inkuan tengteng in na sikhanu adoukhawm ua, a-unaupa thatpa, a-unaupa athah ziak a ka thah sam theihna ding un hon pekhia in, huchi in gouluah dingpa leng ka that pah ngal ding uh, achi uh. Huchibang in ka mei-am omsun amitsak ding ua, ka pasal min nei lou leh leitung a suan himhim nei lou in a-om mai ding," achi hi.
english: Behold, the whole family has risen against your servant, and they say, ‘Deliver him who struck his brother, that we may kill him for the life of his brother whom he killed, and so destroy the heir also.’ Thus they would quench my coal which is left, and would leave to my husband neither name nor remainder on the surface of the earth.”

paite: Kumpipa'n numei kiang ah, "Na inn ah pai inla, na tungtang thu ah thu ka pe mai ding," achi hi.
english: The king said to the woman, “Go to your house, and I will give a command concerning you.”

paite: Tekoa a numei in kumpipa kiang ah, "Ka toupa, kumpipa aw, huai gitlouhna moh ka tung leh ka pa inkote tung ah ke mai hen. Kumpipa leh alaltutphah in moh po kei hen," achi hi.
english: The woman of Tekoa said to the king, “My lord, O king, may the iniquity be on me, and on my father’s house; and may the king and his throne be guiltless.”

paite: Kumpipa'n, "Kuapeuh na tung a banghiam gen peuhmah ka kiang ah hon pi inla, ahon khoih nawn het kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: The king said, “Whoever says anything to you, bring him to me, and he will not bother you any more.”

paite: Ama'n, "Sisan suah mite tung a phula mite'n hihmang nawn lou ding in kumpipa'n TOUPA na Pathian theigige hen aw, huchi lou in zaw ka tapa ahihmang kha ding uh," achi hi. Ama'n, "TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi, na tapa samzang khat lel leng lei ah ake kei ding," achi hi.
english: Then she said, “Please let the king remember Yahweh your God, that the avenger of blood destroy not any more, lest they destroy my son.” He said, “As Yahweh lives, not one hair of your son shall fall to the earth.”

paite: Huchi in numei in, "Na sikhanu in toupa ka kumpipa kiang ah thu kam khat kia ka hon gen nawn peuhmah ding aw," achi hi. Ama'n, "Gen ve," achi hi.
english: Then the woman said, “Please let your servant speak a word to my lord the king.” He said, “Say on.”

paite: Numei in, "Ahihleh bangziak in ahia Pathian mite dou a hichibang a hih tum na hia? Hiai thu a pan kumpipa moh in akilang ahi, kumpipa'n adelhmangpa apikik nawn louh ziak in.
english: The woman said, “Why then have you devised such a thing against the people of God? For in speaking this word the king is as one who is guilty, in that the king does not bring home again his banished one.

paite: Ka si ngeingei ding ua, lei a bosa luah nawn theih louh tuisik bang ka hi uh. Pathian in hinna alamang kei a, adelhmangpa amah a pan hawlkhiak ahihlouhna ding lunggel ahi zaw hi.
english: For we must die, and are like water spilled on the ground, which can’t be gathered up again; neither does God take away life, but devises means, that he who is banished not be an outcast from him.

paite: Huchi in toupa ka kumpipa kiang a hiai thu gen dia ka hong leng mite'n ahon lauhsak ziak uh ahi. Na sikhanu'n, kumpipa kiang ah ka gen phot dia, kumpipa'n asikhanu nget ahihsak khakleh, ka chi a ahi.
english: Now therefore, seeing that I have come to speak this word to my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid. Your servant said, ‘I will now speak to the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his servant.’

paite: Kumpipa'n kei leh ka tapa Pathian gouluah lou dia hihman tum mi lak a na sikhanu hunkhe ding in ana ngaikhe ding, ka chi hi.
english: For the king will hear, to deliver his servant out of the hand of the man who would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God.

paite: Huchi in na sikhanu a ding in, toupa ka kumpipa thu lungmuanhuaitak hi henla; asia-apha na khen ding in toupa ka kumpipa lah Pathian angel bang mai ahi ngal a. TOUPA Pathian na kiang ah om hen, ka chi ahi," achi hi.
english: Then your servant said, ‘Please let the word of my lord the king bring rest; for as an angel of God, so is my lord the king to discern good and bad. May Yahweh, your God, be with you.’”

paite: Kumpipa'n adawng a, numei kiang ah, "K'on dot peuhmah bangmah hon iim ke'n aw," achi hi. Numei in, "Toupa ka kumpipa'n genleh ake," achi hi.
english: Then the king answered the woman, “Please don’t hide anything from me that I ask you.” The woman said, “Let my lord the king now speak.”

paite: Kumpipa'n, "Hiai thu himhim ah Joab in panna anei hia?" achi hi. Numei in adawng a, "Toupa ka kumpipa, na kha ahin bang in ka gen ahi, toupa ka kumpipa'n agensa kuamah in taklam hiam, veilam ah hiam apel thei kei ding uh. Na sikha Joab in hon sawl a, hiai thu tengteng na sikhanu ahon muam vek hi.
english: The king said, “Is the hand of Joab with you in all this?” The woman answered, “As your soul lives, my lord the king, no one can turn to the right hand or to the left from anything that my lord the king has spoken; for your servant Joab urged me, and he put all these words in the mouth of your servant.

paite: Thil omdan hihlamdang ding in hiai thil na sikha Joab in ahih ahi. Ka toupa bel leitung a thil om tengteng theithei Pathian angel bang a pil ahi," achi hi.
english: Your servant Joab has done this thing to change the face of the matter. My lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of God, to know all things that are on the earth.”

paite: Kumpipa'n Joab kiang ah, "Ngai in, ka hih samta hi. Huaiziak in pai inla, tangval Absalom va pi nawn lechin maw," achi hi.
english: The king said to Joab, “Behold now, I have granted this thing. Go therefore, and bring the young man Absalom back.”

paite: Joab in amai a lei si in abokkhup a, kumpipa kiang ah kipahthu agen hi. Joab in, "Toupa ka kumpipa aw, toupa'n asikha ngetna alohchinsak ziak in tuni in na sikha in na mitmuh in deihsakna atang chih ka na theita hi," achi hi.
english: Joab fell to the ground on his face, showed respect, and blessed the king. Joab said, “Today your servant knows that I have found favor in your sight, my lord, O king, in that the king has performed the request of his servant.”

paite: Huchi in Joab athou a, Geshur ah ahoh a, Jerusalem ah Absalom ahon pita hi.
english: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.

paite: Kumpipa'n, "Ama inn ah pai henla, ka mel hong mu kei hen," achi hi. Huchi in ama inn ah Absalom apai a, kumpipa mel amuta kei hi.
english: The king said, “Let him return to his own house, but let him not see my face.” So Absalom returned to his own house, and didn’t see the king’s face.

paite: Israel tengteng lak ah Absalom bang a melhoih a phat loh kuamah a-om kei uh. Akhenuai a pan alusip pha in gensiatna himhim a-om kei hi.
heading: Kumpipa Toh Absalom Kilem Nawn
english: Now in all Israel there was no one to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty. From the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no defect in him.

paite: Asam amet chiang in, kum kivei teng in ametsak a, asam lah agik ziak in amet zel hi, abuk zel a, kumpipa bukna shekel zanih apha hi.
english: When he cut the hair of his head (now it was at every year’s end that he cut it; because it was heavy on him, therefore he cut it), he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels, after the king’s weight.

paite: Absalom in tapa thum leh tanu khat anei a, amin Tamar ahi a, melhoihtak ahi.
english: Three sons were born to Absalom, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar. She was a woman with a beautiful face.

paite: Absalom kum nih hilhial Jerusalem ah a-om a; himahleh kumpipa mel himhim amu kei hi.
english: Absalom lived two full years in Jerusalem, and he didn’t see the king’s face.

paite: Absalom in kumpipa kiang a amah sawl ding in Joab athukhak hi. Himahleh ahoh nuam kei a, athukhak nawn in leng ahoh nuam tuan kei hi.
english: Then Absalom sent for Joab, to send him to the king, but he would not come to him. Then he sent again a second time, but he would not come.

paite: Huchi in asikhate kiang ah, "I aw, Joab lou, kei lou kiang ahi a, barli buh anei a, va hal un," achi hi. Huchi in Absalom sikhate'n lou ava hal uhi.
english: Therefore he said to his servants, “Behold, Joab’s field is near mine, and he has barley there. Go and set it on fire.” So Absalom’s servants set the field on fire.

paite: Huchi in Joab athou a, Absalom kiang ah a-inn ah ahoh a, "Bangziak a na sikhate'n ka lou hal ahi ua?" achi hi.
english: Then Joab arose and came to Absalom to his house, and said to him, “Why have your servants set my field on fire?”

paite: Absalom in Joab adawng a, "Ngai dih, bang ding a Geshur a pan hong pai ka hia? Huai ah omden leng kei a dia hoihzaw mah ding hiven. Kumpipa kiang a sawl dia hon thukhak ka hi. Huaiziak in tu in kumpipa mel hon musak in. Tatlekna nei ka hihleh hon that maileh ake," achi hi.
english: Absalom answered Joab, “Behold, I sent to you, saying, ‘Come here, that I may send you to the king, to say, “Why have I come from Geshur? It would be better for me to be there still. Now therefore, let me see the king’s face; and if there is iniquity in me, let him kill me.”’”

paite: Kumpipa kiang ah Joab ahoh a, ahilh hi. Ama'n Absalom asam a, kumpipa kiang ah ahoh a, kumpipa ma ah amai a lei si in abokkhup a; huchi in kumpipa'n Absalom atawp hi.
english: So Joab came to the king and told him; and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king; and the king kissed Absalom.
